name: A.B. Phillips & Sons Fruit Farm
tagline: A.B.Phillips & Sons Fruit Farm – Buckeye Harvest Market Cooperative
description: A.B. Phillips & Sons Fruit Farm is an agritourism farm in 30 E. Main Street, OH, open to visitors for seasonal picking and farm activities. Offerings follow the growing season, so what is available changes through the year. Check the website for current hours and availability.
